name: hv16_dbk_vp4_ctl_rt80-rt80-fb3d6ff98
purpose: DMA STORE back controller leaf for the d4g die: RR_RT 80 (VM read round trip at the controller pins, d4g budget: faces bank pin flop + GEN2c lanes 33..58, worst-case landing E 72, GEN2d headroom; die pads the 17-bit rq lanes). Landing slot = landing counter, response mask rebuilt from 2 delayed bits/edge (issued, last partial column); minimum drain lag RR_RT+3 enforced. ONE master for all four quadrants (stk strap). Bench: tb_dma_vp4_banklat faces bank model + GEN2c NE lanes padded to 80 PASS through the real landing SRAMs; mutants old latency 7 / pad short / lag-1 FAIL. Pins/faces = HH-7 per-face controller (bank_read_addr/slots split S/W/N, claude/hh7-dbkcpl-1019).
